- You already provide a PYBIND11_MODULE in your CUDA source.
- You also asked load_inline to autogenerate bindings via functions=["conv2d_bf16"].

This causes a generated main.cpp that expects a visible declaration for conv2d_bf16 and conflicts with your own module definition. The minimal fix is to remove the functions argument so load_inline compiles your CUDA source (with your PYBIND11_MODULE) as-is.
